name: capell-app/filament-peek
description: Adds a Preview changes button to the Page editor that shows your unsaved edits in the real theme, with Desktop, Tablet and Mobile views.

healthChecks.label: Filament Peek preview routes, actions, and service provider are discoverable.

marketplace.summary: See how a new headline or photo will look in your real theme before you save, with nothing saved or published.
marketplace.description: Filament Peek puts a Preview changes button on a Page's edit screen. It renders what is currently in the form, including an unsaved page-builder arrangement, using the site's real theme and layout, with a clear Unsaved preview banner. Editors switch between Desktop, Tablet and Mobile and rotate the smaller sizes. Previews are private to the editor who opened them, expire after 15 minutes by default and are not indexed by search engines. No new permissions are added, and it needs a working cache but no database changes.
marketplace.problem: I save half-finished pages just to see how a headline or image will look.
marketplace.outcome: Editors preview unsaved Page edits in the real theme on three device sizes, then save only when happy.

faq.question: Does Preview changes save or publish anything?
faq.answer: No. It shows the page in your site's real theme with everything you have typed so far, and it saves nothing and publishes nothing.

faq.question: Can I send the preview to a colleague or client?
faq.answer: No. By default the preview lasts 15 minutes and only you can open it, and a link sent to someone else shows Preview unavailable. For review and sign-off, use Publishing Studio, a separate package that gives reviewers a link of their own.

faq.question: Which content can I preview?
faq.answer: Pages only, and only for people who may already edit that page. A moved block shows up if you use the page builder.

faq.question: Will the preview look exactly like the live page?
faq.answer: No. It won't match the live page pixel for pixel. A banner reads Unsaved preview, not published, and clicking inside the frame is limited.

faq.question: Can I see how the page looks on a tablet or phone?
faq.answer: Yes. Desktop, Tablet and Mobile buttons resize the window, and Rotate turns a tablet or phone sideways.
